one_line: A grab-bag of smallSurfShack additions: a wand of tweaking, a gator cloak, new uplink items (execution sword, grenade launcher, bowling kit), two nanite medicines, clown/noose crafting recipes, a holographic xenobiology manual, an AI request-shell action, a drop-all-equipment helper, and a weave hair style.
player_facing_mechanics: Fire the wand of tweaking at a target (or yourself) to apply the tweak component for 5 minutes
Find a mysterious wand fragment (one of three)
Wear the gator cloak, which hides hair, face and ears
Purchase the Execution Sword from the uplink (1 TC, surplus 30, not purchasable by infiltrators)
Purchase the Grenade Launcher from the uplink as Chemist or Chief Medical Officer (9 TC, surplus 25)
Purchase the Bowling Kit from the uplink (11 TC, surplus 20) containing 5 bowling balls, 4 bowling pins, bowling shoes and a bowling jersey
Brew naniteremover (aluminium+iron+bromine+silicon) and nanitebooster (naniteremover+oil) via chemistry
Learn clown prop recipes from a mind proc and craft the spinning banana prop (cable coil 15, banana 1, bananium 3)
Craft a noose from cable coil (NOOSE_CABLE_COST), takes 1 second
Read the Xenobiology Manual (holomanual), which opens an HTML manual UI and fits in a wallet
As an AI, use the Request Remote Shell action once to pod-spawn a cyborg shell at your turf
Drop all equipped and held equipment via drop_all_equipment proc
Select the Weave hair sprite accessory
tg_systems_used: magic gun / ammo casing / projectile system
uplink item datums (cost, surplus, purchasable_from, restricted_roles)
data_only_parts: gator_cloak clothing definition and icon/flags overrides
execution_sword uplink datum (item path, cost 1, surplus 30, purchasable_from)
nadelauncher uplink datum (item path, cost 9, surplus 25, restricted_roles)
bowling kit box definition and its PopulateContents item list
naniteremover and nanitebooster chemical reactions (reagent lists and results)
logic_parts: wand zap_self applying the tweak component to the user
projectile on_hit applying the tweak component to the hit atom
syndie bowling kit PopulateContents spawning 5 balls, 4 pins, shoes and jersey
teach_clown_prop_recipies adding clown prop subtypes to a mind's learned_recipes
holomanual ui_interact loading and opening the slime manual HTML through SSfrogui
request_shell Activate doing podspawn of a shell robot with cell
human drop_all_equipment iterating equipped and held items and dropping them
byond_specific: SSfrogui.open_ui / FROGUI_NO_TOPIC custom UI framework call
static var/ui caching a browse-style HTML file ('surfshack13/frogui/slime_manual.html')
podspawn helper with style /datum/pod_style/centcom and spawn mob path
port_notes: Most of this is pure data that maps cleanly to SS14 YAML prototypes: the gator cloak and hair become entity prototypes and a marking/sprite accessory; the two uplink items and the bowling kit become store listing entries plus an entity-storage fill; the two chemical reactions and the two crafting recipes become reagent/crafting prototypes, and the request-shell AI action becomes a player action with a spawn event. Real behaviour code is limited to the wand's projectile hit and self-zap applying the tweak component (an SS14 component + system or status effect, with the 5-minute duration as a status-effect prototype), the bowling kit's contents fill, and the drop_all_equipment helper which maps to an inventory system helper. Open questions for a human: what /datum/component/tweak actually does (it is defined elsewhere and not in this source), whether the Execution Sword, bowling clothing/balls/pins and nanite reagents/SSfrogui manual HTML all exist or must be ported separately, and whether SSfrogui should be replaced by SS14's guidebook UI rather than reimplemented.
